feeds.title: WPGraphQL Blog
feeds.description: GraphQL API for WordPress WPGraphQL is a free, open-source WordPress plugin that provides an extendable GraphQL schema and API for any WordPress site. With GraphQL, the client makes declarative queries, asking for the exact data needed.
